verdict.rationale: The Colorado Secretary of State is a government business-registry and filing office. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it hosts user automations: email notifications, mass registered-agent changes, and a read-only open-data API are not automation workflows with version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
